name: THORChain DEX
rootCause: Even the old gods cannot escape the exploits. As the cross-chain attacks continue, THORChain becomes the latest victim. $5 million lost.

descriptions.text: Even the old gods cannot escape the exploits. As the cross-chain attacks continue, THORChain becomes the latest victim. $5 million lost.

The decentralized cross-chain transaction protocol THORChain (RUNE) updated the attack situation, claiming that the amount of lost assets was about 4000 ETH. The initial assessment is that the attack was a logical vulnerability when Eth Bifrost used the routing contract to capture ERC-20 tokens. The attacker use. Not long ago, THORChain updated Eth Bifrost to allow the routing contract to be "encapsulated" by the contract.
